acceptanceCriteria: All three file notices agree with the accepted path map or an explicit owner-approved exception that names them; a targeted source-header check and the release legal-file digest gate pass.
Preserve the existing license notices and granted rights until the owner records the exact intended terms and provenance; no automatic relicensing.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, SUP-01. Source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

A source recipient reading cmd/corvint/frontier.go, frontier_adapters.go, or frontier_test.go sees an Apache-2.0 notice, while the accepted path map puts cmd/** in the AGPL product layer and allows a file-specific exception only when separately owner-approved. No such exception was located in decision 0002 or the relevant Frontier decisions. This leaves the policy basis for these product-command notices undocumented; the notices themselves must be preserved until intended terms are resolved.

Source: cmd/corvint/frontier.go:1; cmd/corvint/frontier_adapters.go:1; cmd/corvint/frontier_test.go:1; LICENSING.md:8; LICENSING.md:37; docs/decisions/0002-future-publication-transition.md:21; docs/specs/change-frontier-v0.md:545

Observed checks: "At commit 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a, an exact header search found only these three Apache-noticed .go files outside protocol/, conformance/, interop/, and examples/. Checked decision 0002 and Frontier references for an approved exception; no exception found. No legal interpretation or public artifact examination was performed."

Owning contract: "LICENSING.md path boundary; decision 0002; AGENTS.md licensing rule"

Correction: Confirm the intended terms and provenance for these three files with the owner before changing any notice. If the Apache notices are deliberate, record the exact owner-approved exception in decision 0002 and align LICENSING.md and release notices; if not, make an owner-approved correction that preserves granted rights and provenance.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; original reports and evidence: .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Focused checks plus independent review are required for repair; any native release qualification needs the selected candidate and owner-dispatched run. No qualification or promotion is implied by this ticket.
title: Resolve the documented license boundary for three Frontier command files
